Question ID: ENG3_U06_L07_Q01

MLA.ENG3.C.03 Context: A multimedia product includes writing, a source chart, and a short spoken introduction. Which choice best shows integration?\

answer.text: Each part uses a different topic.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Different topics make the product confusing. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

answer.text: Each part supports the same research claim for the same audience.

feedback.text: Correct. Integration means the parts work together toward one purpose. Notice how the answer uses the exact wording, evidence, or concept required by the standard.

answer.text: The chart is decorative and not explained.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Unexplained decoration does not support communication. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

answer.text: The introduction avoids mentioning the written claim.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The spoken part should connect to the product's purpose. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

MLA.ENG3.C.03 Context: A final product has many convention errors in captions. Why is this a problem?\

feedback.text: Incorrect. Captions are useful when they explain multimedia. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

answer.text: Errors can distract the audience and reduce credibility.

MLA.ENG3.C.03 Context: A product has a strong written claim but unrelated images. What is the best revision?\

MLA.ENG3.C.03 Context: A student prepares to export a LAN publication. Which final check is most useful?\

feedback.text: Incorrect. Fancy fonts can reduce readability. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Too much information can overwhelm readers. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Digital publication still needs proofreading. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.
